newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested.

Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 200 slaughter steers and 400 heifers; 28,600 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 17,400 formulated and 1,000 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs
Wk to Date - 28,600 Week ago - 97,000 Year ago - 79,000
